feed_title: Outdoor Dog Kennel, Raised Floor, Ventilated Weatherproof Plastic Shell, Arched Doorway, Navy, One Size | PawLunova Blencathra
descriptionHtml:
A raised floor. A ventilated shell. Somewhere dry while you are out there.

Blencathra is a raised-floor outdoor dog kennel with a ventilated plastic shell and an arched doorway, in one size, for supervised garden use.

You are out there for two hours and so are they. They find a dry patch by the wall, drop onto it, and get up again ten minutes later once the ground has taken the warmth back out of them. Then the step. Then the path. Then back to the wall.

This gives them one spot that stays put, with a floor that sits clear of the ground.

What they get

  • A floor clear of the ground: Wet grass stays outside, and bedding is not lying in the damp.
  • A sloped shell and an arched doorway: Rain runs off the shape rather than settling on top of it.
  • Ventilation through the shell: Air passes through instead of standing still around them.
  • Plastic rather than fabric: Wipe it with a damp cloth and mild soap. Nothing to launder, and bedding is not included.

Best for: A supervised garden retreat in suitable conditions.

Why it is worth the money

£119 buys a shell and a raised floor, and both of them wipe down. There is no fabric in it to soak up a wet afternoon, no filling to pack down and nothing to put through a machine at the end of a muddy fortnight.

Take the next line as seriously as we mean it. This is a garden addition, not a replacement for the comfort and safety of indoor housing. It is where the afternoon happens, not the night.

The honest part: we do not publish the measurements for this one, and we are not going to guess them at you. Ask us first and we will send the internal floor, the entrance height and the supported load.

Size and fit

Please contact us for the exact dimensions before ordering. Check the internal resting area, entrance height and supported load. Your dog should be able to enter, stand, turn and lie comfortably.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for any cushion, and store soft furnishings under cover. Let every part dry before use.

Outdoor use: Supervise your dog, provide drinking water and safe shade, and move them indoors in extreme weather. A raised bed, canopy or kennel does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Choose with confidence

This outdoor product has a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost. It is not covered by the 100-night sleep trial. Your statutory rights are unaffected. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Does bedding come with it? No. You are buying the shell and the raised floor, so put in whatever they already sleep on and wash it as usual.

How is this different from Keswick? Keswick is the same raised idea at £129 with an access ramp up to the doorway. Take Keswick if a step up is the problem.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Ask us for the internal measurements and give them a dry raised floor in the garden.
